[h2][i]"Why did the deer run toward the stars?"
[/i][/h2]

[h3]The Deer dashes through the cosmos of 『KALPA』.  
A special journey to find rhythm even in chaos—alongside 『DEEEER Simulator』.
The rhythm game 『KALPA: Cosmic Symphony』 and the town-destroying simulator 『DEEEER Simulator』 present a special collaboration!
This DLC features music blending the emotions of both titles, along with exclusive patterns, stickers, profile icons, and other decorative items.
When a strange deer appears atop familiar rhythms, what kind of performance will you create?

Decorative Items:

Also, don't miss the April Fools' Day special event—encounter it randomly during gameplay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868358/c0292bb8614ad763d41f84e5499b4197e3d04dfe.png[/img]

[h1]The First Forte Update Complete.[/h1]

[h3]Hello, this is QueseraGames.

The update was completed on October 25, 2024. You can use the game normally after updating the game version.

Please refer to the details below for more information on the update.[/h3]

[h1] New Songs Added to Main Game [/h1]
[h2]A total of 5 new songs have been added to KALPA: Cosmic Symphony’s main content.[/h2]

[h1] New DLC Release [/h1]

[h2][b]First Forte Pack [/b][/h2] https://store.steampowered.com/app/3295260

[h2][b]Rizline Collaboration Pack [/b][/h2] https://store.steampowered.com/app/3290790

[h1] Content Updates [/h1]

[h2][list]
[*]Diagonal panel play is now supported in multiplayer mode.

[*]The BAD rating has been added to Lunatic mode.
This feature will be in a trial phase for now, and both pre- and post-trial records will be stored during this period.
When officially implemented, all Lunatic records prior to the trial phase will be removed.

[*]A sectional performance system has been added.
Sectional ratings have been updated to match rank levels, and Perfect and S section distinctions are now available.

[*]Ghost Battles have been added.
A new function now allows you to select records on the ranking board to compete against.
[/list][/h2]

[h1] Other Changes [/h1]

[h2][list]
[*]The levels of certain patterns have been adjusted.
Once again (VIP) 5K COSMOS
LV 20 -> LV 21

Bathin 5K COSMOS
LV 21 -> LV 20
[/list][/h2]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 2024.08.23
notes.content:
[h1][Notice][/h1]

We have announced on the Stove page that an exclusive track will be provided upon the official release. The same exclusive track is planned to be provided for the Steam version upon its official release as well. To avoid any feelings of discrimination among players on both platforms, the exclusive track will be designed as a twin track. The multiplayer mode scheduled for September is being developed with cross-platform support in mind.

[h1][Convenience Improvements / Major Bug Fixes][/h1]

Fixed a bug where the system judgment line was working in reverse in-game.
Modified the animation for Plus/Minus for better readability.
Fixed a bug where the game would not function properly when the sample rate did not match after changing sound devices.(We were unable to test on a variety of devices. If any issues arise after the patch, please report the bugs.)
Enabled the Alt key to be added in key settings.
Added an option for background sound playback.
Added a feature to align judgment and combo display to the center of the panel.
Changed the key used for judgment test in Play Customize from Spacebar to the input key.
Changed the Auto Sync Setup button from Spacebar to the assigned button.
Added a countdown when retrying during play.
Fixed the ranking window to display Lunatic rankings when opened in Lunatic mode.

[h1][Minor Convenience Improvements / Bug Fixes][/h1]

Improved BPM display UI for better readability.
Changed the Lunatic switch button for "Your Steps" to F3.
Updated the text description on the main screen.
Corrected a typo in V-Sync.
Fixed category navigation so that when moving past the end in one direction, it loops to the opposite end.

notes.title: 2024.08.16 Hotfix
notes.content:
Ranking Popup

- Fixed an issue where the UI would overlap if the song title is too long.
- Fixed an issue where the "My Record" UI would not appear if a difficulty level without a record was selected.
- Added a feature that allows the scroll to move continuously when the up or down buttons are held down.

Play Customize

- Fixed an issue where the plus and minus size change would be applied to the combo.
- Fixed an issue where the sound would suddenly increase after exiting the Simple Sync Popup.
- Added a feature in which note speed can be changed with the mouse.

Settings

- Fixed an issue where the BGM would stop after exiting the popup.
- Fixed an issue where the Section Performance options could not be clicked with the mouse.
- Fixed an issue where the BGM would turn off when modifying the buffer size.
- Fixed an issue where the NVIDIA option would reset when re-entering the game.

Playlist

- Fixed an issue where a different difficulty would be selected after returning from playing a song in difficulty sorting.
- Fixed an issue where the score and combo numbers were swapped.
- Fixed an issue where the text for adding and removing favorites was reversed.

Results Screen

- Fixed an issue where the album art was cropped.

- Fixed an issue where the UI would overlap if the song title is too long.

- Fixed an issue where the score was not rounded to the nearest ten.

(For existing records, a separate server patch will be scheduled.)

Story

- Fixed an issue where sound effects would not play in the difficulty options.
- Fixed a text error in Episode 2 Chapter 1.
- Fixed an issue where certain characters would not display correctly in the Chinese font.
- Fixed an issue where the game would freeze if the choice buttons were pressed quickly during the story.

In-Game

- Fixed an issue where sound effects would not play on the pause screen.
- Modified so that note speed can be changed with the mouse on the pause screen.
- Added a plus and minus scale effect.

Your Traces

- Fixed an issue where the score display was incorrect for 5K.
- Fixed an issue where the Lunatic play count was not displayed.
- Fixed an issue where the Lunatic play record was not updated immediately after playing.

notes.title: [2024/02/20]We have updated to fix some of the bugs found in the demo.
notes.content:
We have updated KALPA: Cosmic Symphony to fix some of the bugs found in the demo.
Performers are kindly requested to install the updated version on STEAM.

[Fixed Bugs]
We've made some optimizations to the playscreen.
Changed the maximum doubling speed to 15 and the modifiable interval to 0.1.
Fixed the default offset for syncs.
Changed the notation of syncs.
Added the ability to adjust sync by pressing the keyboard in time with a sound.
Fixed an issue where the game would start in fullscreen regardless of the options set at startup.
Fixed an issue where pressing the keyboard during a clear sound would result in no sound.
Fixed an issue where there was no sound when achieving a perfect.
Fixed the display issue related to the results screen UI

[Known and Working on Bug]
There is a bug where the display appears abnormal if the resolution is not 16:9.
